review.scope: Generated original at source size only; no native-scale or runtime acceptance.
observations: All 32 full-body sprites are complete with transparent gutters; no gross grid or cropping defect observed.
All eight headings occur in each row. NE/N/NW present actual back torso armor, rear panels and ponytail, not erased front faces.
Olive skin, black beard and tied-back hair, bronze-gold riveted armor, round belt buckle, dark-green tabard and brown boots retain Joh Haynes identity distinct from Fluup.
Empty hands, no weapons, baked effects, text, grid marks, ground shadows or environment observed.
Rise row uses clearly bent/tucked legs with balancing arms; descent row extends boots farther down with hands readied for landing.
Bottom row has visibly deeper knee/pelvis compression and forward torso lean than first-row anticipation.
Head/body scale is broadly consistent by source-size inspection; exact native-scale skull, body-volume and silhouette continuity require lead review.
The generated PNG contains substantial partial alpha. No alpha cleanup, registration, crop, resizing or image manipulation was performed.
limitations: Side/rear arms and legs naturally overlap in some views, and descent feet are slightly staggered.
Row 1 remains a fairly mild squat compared with the deep bottom-row landing.
Numerical pose-height targets were prompting guidance and were not measured or proven at native game scale.
Four authored key poses are not completed animation cycles or independent casting animations.
Lead-owned alpha thresholding, hidden-RGB cleanup, registration and downsampling are pending.
